testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect properties of an inactive document from its tab: tmp/obk-tab-context-3900/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:59:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect properties of an inactive document from its tab ✔ Given the MCAD Software has two open part documents ✔ And the first part is active ✔ And the second part has been saved ✔ When the user opens the second part's document tab context menu ✔ Then the first part remains active in the workspace ✔ When the user chooses Properties from the context menu ✔ Then the properties dialog identifies the second part ✔ And its General page displays the file name, location, size and timestamps ✔ When the user closes the properties dialog without making changes ✔ Then the first part remains active in the workspace ✔ And the second part remains open
